<!-- Generated by docs-infra Python API -->

```python
current_builder() -> 'ir.Builder'
```

Part of [`evoxc.trace`](/api/evoxc/trace/)

Return the innermost active `ir.Builder`.

## Raises

- `core.TraceError` — When no trace (or control-flow region) is active —
  i.e. an op function was called outside `evoxc.trace` / `evoxc.cond` /
  `evoxc.while_loop` / `evoxc.scan` bodies. The message names all
  three entry points (`@evoxc.defn`-traced definitions, `evoxc.trace`,
  `evoxc.evaluate`).
